caption:
Say: O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.

Surah Az-Zumar (39:10). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #Patience #Sabr #IslamicReminder #Deen

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 39:10, Surah Az-Zumar, on patience and unreckoned reward. Not used by any prior post (checked against existing blankdiscussions meta.json files). Standing 8-language/10-slide format.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, live call api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/39:10/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-04); fetched twice in the same script and the two responses diffed identical; slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields, no retyping.
sourcing.english: Edition en.sahih (Saheeh International), same call, byte-identical.
sourcing.chinese: Edition zh.jian (Ma Jian), same call, byte-identical.
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, translator 'Unknown' per source so slide says 'Translator not specified by source'. Byte-identical; artifact scan (double spaces, space before punctuation, leading/trailing whitespace, control chars) found none.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, translator 'Unknown' per source, byte-identical, same artifact scan clean.
sourcing.thai: Edition th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), byte-identical.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: Slide text left byte-identical to the API, nothing edited. Only the caption drops the quotation marks from the English line for readability; no word changed.
sourcing.verification_note: Live fetch performed this session in the same script that wrote the slide files. No wording from memory.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 142 string terms in compliance-policy.json halal section across all slide text: 0 hits.
